## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**  
RISK-OFF. Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: defensives showing leadership (JNJ ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.45% | 1M: +9.68%) and PM ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.79% | 1M: +10.89%)) and Financials/Industrials are net negative (Financials 1W: -0.32%; Industrials 1W: -1.28%), so defensive tone is supported; major divergence among large-cap tech names warrants caution. Leadership: Moderate concentration (3/5 Technology in Top 5).

**2. Which sectors are leading?**  
Materials lead: NEM ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.97% | 1M: +24.74%) and FCX ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.03% | 1M: +20.26%). Technology strong but uneven: TXN ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.19% | 1M: +22.21%), META ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.10% | 1M: +0.82%) and NVDA ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.47% | 1M: +0.52%).

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**  
Healthcare lagging: UNH BELOW TREND (1W: -15.45% | 1M: -11.39%), LLY BELOW TREND (1W: -5.07% | 1M: -5.01%), ABT BELOW TREND (1W: -12.16% | 1M: -14.62%). Financials weak: JPM BELOW TREND (1W: -0.42% | 1M: -7.86%) and COF BELOW TREND (1W: -5.45% | 1M: -12.40%).

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**  
Top 5: TXN ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.19% | 1M: +22.21%), NEM ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.97% | 1M: +24.74%), META ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.10% | 1M: +0.82%), MSFT RECOVERY (1W: +8.45% | 1M: -1.25%), GILD ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.22% | 1M: +12.04%). Leadership: Moderate concentration (3/5 Technology).

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**  
Bottom 5: UNH BELOW TREND (1W: -15.45% | 1M: -11.39%), ABT BELOW TREND (1W: -12.16% | 1M: -14.62%), INTC CORRECTION (1W: -10.08% | 1M: +34.75%), CVS BELOW TREND (1W: -8.41% | 1M: -6.24%), GE BELOW TREND (1W: -8.17% | 1M: -7.08%). Weakness concentrated in Healthcare and select Industrials.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**  
Best 1W movers: TXN ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.19% | 1M: +22.21%), NEM ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.97% | 1M: +24.74%), META ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.10% | 1M: +0.82%). Major divergence warning: several large-caps (MSFT RECOVERY (1W: +8.45% | 1M: -1.25%), AAPL RECOVERY (1W: +3.55% | 1M: -6.20%), INTC CORRECTION) show 1W vs 1M mismatch — treat as tactical, not structural.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**  
Technology mixed but positive on balance; NVDA ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.47% | 1M: +0.52%), TXN ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.19% | 1M: +22.21%), MSFT RECOVERY (1W: +8.45% | 1M: -1.25%) — watch for profit-taking given RECOVERY signals. Sector breadth: ~11/19 positive (Internal Rotation).

**8. Financials Outlook?**  
Financials soft: JPM BELOW TREND (1W: -0.42% | 1M: -7.86%), COF BELOW TREND (1W: -5.45% | 1M: -12.40%), V POTENTIAL REVERSAL → RECOVERY (1W: +0.52% | 1M: -7.89%) — breadth weak, watch credit-sensitive names. Sector breadth: ~6/20 positive (Sector Weakness).

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**  
Healthcare under pressure with pockets of strength: JNJ ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.45% | 1M: +9.68%) and GILD ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.22% | 1M: +12.04%) offset heavy losers UNH BELOW TREND and ABT BELOW TREND. Sector breadth: ~5/15 positive (Sector Weakness).

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**  
Favor defensive and selective materials exposure given the RISK-OFF tone; focus on JNJ ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.45% | 1M: +9.68%), PM ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.79% | 1M: +10.89%) and NEM ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.97% | 1M: +24.74%). Reduce exposure to weak healthcare/financial names showing structural BELOW TREND risk (UNH, COF, ABT); monitor tech RECOVERY names for confirmation before adding exposure.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: TXN ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.19% | 1M: +22.21%), NEM ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.97% | 1M: +24.74%), META ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.10% | 1M: +0.82%) — momentum confirmed. BEARISH: UNH BELOW TREND (1W: -15.45% | 1M: -11.39%), ABT BELOW TREND (1W: -12.16% | 1M: -14.62%), CVS BELOW TREND (1W: -8.41% | 1M: -6.24%) — downside risk persists.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: Materials (Sector Strength) and Energy (Sector Strength) on 1W leadership. BEARISH: Healthcare and Financials given cluster of BELOW TREND names and negative 1W performance.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**  
NVDA ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.47% | 1M: +0.52%): watch near prior resistance for continuation vs consolidation. AAPL RECOVERY (1W: +3.55% | 1M: -6.20%): monitor 1W follow-through as RECOVERY confirms. UNH BELOW TREND (1W: -15.45% | 1M: -11.39%): watch for further breakdown on earnings/comments.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**  
GILD (+80): Gilead’s oncology win; price confirming — GILD ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.22% | 1M: +12.04%). NVDA (+60): China H200 approval headline and AI tailwinds; NVDA ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.47% | 1M: +0.52%) — sentiment and price aligned. META (+55): beat and AI spending guide; META ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.10% | 1M: +0.82%) — confirming accumulation. JNJ (+55): solid Q4; JNJ ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.45% | 1M: +9.68%).

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**  
CVS (-50): antitrust/media scrutiny; CVS BELOW TREND (1W: -8.41% | 1M: -6.24%) — sentiment confirming price weakness. ABT (-50): earnings-led selloff; ABT BELOW TREND (1W: -12.16% | 1M: -14.62%) — confirmed distribution. MSFT (-45): earnings disappointment headlines but MSFT RECOVERY (1W: +8.45% | 1M: -1.25%) — news is somewhat divergent from short-term price bounce, monitor for follow-through.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-OFF with a Defensive/Value tilt given defensive leadership and weak Financials/Industrials. JNJ ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.45% | 1M: +9.68%), TXN ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.19% | 1M: +22.21%) and NEM ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.97% | 1M: +24.74%) are showing relative strength. Key risk: major divergence across large caps (MSFT RECOVERY, AAPL RECOVERY, INTC CORRECTION) and mixed news sentiment for INTC/MSFT could prompt trend breaks—watch for confirmation.
